title: Tell Everyone | Liberty Biberty | Liberty Mutual Insurance Commercial

segments.description: Medium shot of a man opening his car door on a suburban street, startled to find a fluffy yellow creature wearing a Statue of Liberty crown sitting on the roof.
Medium close-up shot as the fluffy yellow mascot introduces itself as 'Liberty Biberty' and talks about getting great car insurance coverage and savings.
Medium shot showing the man reacting in utter confusion and backing away in alarm as the mascot pops up again, building comedic tension.
Medium tracking shot of another man washing his car in a driveway with a hose, suddenly startled as the yellow mascot slides across the roof of his car.
Close-up shot of Liberty Biberty sitting on the car roof delivering the brand slogan about great coverage and savings.
Wide graphic screen showing the Liberty Mutual logo and company jingle, concluding the commercial with the mascot rolling across the bottom of the frame.
